structural_date_resolver.contract: If classifyDate(date).hasDailyReadings is false and classification is holy_week_structural_only_not_in_daily, use reverse_lectionary_index.jsonl for Pascha/Bright Saturday structural rows. Do not treat the daily file omission as data loss.
structural_date_resolver.pascha_computus: Julian/Coptic Pascha converted to Gregorian with 13-day offset for the shipped range.

occasion_index_fields.service_section: Service section for the reading when present.
occasion_index_fields.service_hour: Service hour for the reading when present.
occasion_index_fields.slot: Original reading slot label from the source pipeline, preserved for provenance.
occasion_index_fields.slot_type: Normalized slot category, such as prophecy, psalm, gospel, pauline, catholicon, or praxis.
occasion_index_fields.slot_order: Source-backed reading order within the service hour and normalized slot family when determinable; null only for preserved unmapped source labels.
occasion_index_fields.occasion_kind: Occasion classification: specific for dated/named occasions, cycle for generic cycle or rule labels.
occasion_index_fields.identity_key: Stable reading identity key used for reverse lookup.
occasion_index_fields.display_ref: Human-facing reference, using MT primary with LXX inline where applicable.
occasion_index_fields.canonical_mt_ref: Canonical Masoretic Text reference when available.
occasion_index_fields.spans_json: Serialized span metadata for machine consumers. Empty array is allowed for named non-standard readings that cannot be represented as biblical chapter/verse spans, such as Memoirs of Job.
occasion_index_fields.removed_marker: Source-derived removal or omission marker when present.
occasion_index_fields.hour_theme: Theme label attached to the service hour when present.
occasion_index_fields.source_disclosure: Disclosure of source coverage or source-derived status.
occasion_index_fields.attestation_year_min: Minimum attested year in the packaged source data.
occasion_index_fields.attestation_year_max: Maximum attested year in the packaged source data.

schema_notes.daily_file_shape: Each daily JSON file maps ISO dates to an array of readings sorted by reading_order. Each reading includes reading_order, service_order, slot_type, and slot_order; slot_order may repeat within split Psalm/reading fragments, while reading_order is unique per date.
schema_notes.structural_date_resolver: meta.structural_date_resolver lists shipped-year dates intentionally omitted from daily files because they are structural Holy Week/Bright Saturday rows resolved through reverse_lectionary_index.jsonl.
schema_notes.psalm_dual_numbering: Psalm display_ref may include inline LXX numbering in parentheses. Use canonical_mt_ref, canonical_lxx_ref, and spans_json for machine matching.
schema_notes.canonicalization_notes: canonicalization_note values are source/provenance hints, not date or service resolvers.
schema_notes.multi_source_family: The same identity_key may appear across multiple source_family values and distinct occasions; this is expected attestation breadth, not a duplicate by itself.
schema_notes.source_priority_projection: When current copticchurch.net date-resolved rows overlap lower-priority cycle rows for the same normalized consumer context/service/hour/slot but disagree on passage span, the npm package omits the lower-priority variant. See meta.projection_rules for counts and examples.
schema_notes.coptic_month_spellings: Runtime package labels normalize Kiak to Kiahk and Baba to Babah.
schema_notes.weekday_specific_disambiguation: When a Sunday-specific fixed-date row has a generic sibling with the same reading identity, the generic sibling is labeled as a non-Sunday context to avoid consumer duplicate grouping.
schema_notes.known_limitation: Structural-only occasions without a gregorian_date, including Bright Saturday and special services, are not in the daily files yet.
